subject.title: Draft: add read-only CLI catalog and operator views

question: Should OpenClaw core own this CLI catalog and plugin descriptor metadata contract, and which existing command and tool registries should be canonical for its output?
rationale: The patch creates a top-level CLI, multiple JSON contracts, and plugin-facing API fields while the linked RFC and permanent ownership model remain unapproved.

options.title: Sponsor a canonical projection
options.body: Accept the feature only as a projection of explicitly named canonical registries, with minimal documented plugin metadata and completeness/error semantics.

options.title: Own an independent catalog
options.body: Accept a separate catalog source of truth and explicitly commit to synchronization, versioning, compatibility, and long-term schema maintenance.

options.title: Pause for RFC resolution
options.body: Keep the implementation draft open but defer further merge work until the RFC chooses the core boundary and consumer contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a canonical projection
recommendation.body: Accept the feature only as a projection of explicitly named canonical registries, with minimal documented plugin metadata and completeness/error semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects this person to the plugin CLI loader, descriptor contract, SDK docs, and adjacent catalog ownership surfaces.
